briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 push multi-agent capabilities as US-China AI export controls tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month with rapid capability gains in reasoning and agentic workflows. Compute shortages persist while regulatory scrutiny on export controls intensifies between the US and China.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with improved long-horizon planning. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.5 show gains in code and multimodal tasks. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 120B while DeepSeek released R2 with competitive benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic system risks amid rising adversarial attacks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $4B data center expansion in Texas focused on 100k H100 clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent orchestration breakthroughs trigger an intelligence explosion before 2028 safety frameworks mature?
